description: Proxmox Backup Server: host and datastore metrics pushed through its InfluxDB metric server, plus backup, verify, prune and garbage collection results pushed by the health timer from resources/pbs.

panels.title: Fullest datastore
panels.description: Used share of the fullest datastore. The alerts warn above 80% and go critical above 90%.

panels.title: Datastores unavailable
panels.description: Datastores PBS cannot open, for example one whose disk is not mounted or does not answer.

panels.title: Failed backups
panels.description: Guests whose newest backup task ended with an error.

panels.title: Oldest last backup
panels.description: Age of the oldest last-successful backup of any guest. A daily guest warns at 36 hours.

panels.title: Backups by guest
panels.description: Every guest with its last successful backup, its usual interval (read from the spacing of its newest snapshots) and the result of its newest backup task. Oldest first.

panels.title: Age of the last backup
panels.description: How long ago each guest was last backed up successfully. It saws between backups; a line that keeps climbing past its interval is a guest that stopped being backed up.

panels.title: Failed backups
panels.description: Guests whose newest backup task failed, over time. A failure clears when the next backup of that guest succeeds.

panels.title: Scheduled jobs
panels.description: The last run of every verify, prune and garbage collection job. A failure stays until the job runs again.

panels.title: Garbage collection
panels.description: What the last garbage collection freed (removed) and what it found but kept for now (pending, chunks too recent to delete).

panels.title: Task health
panels.description: 1 is a job whose last run was OK, 0 a failure.

panels.title: Datastore usage
panels.description: Used share of each datastore. Dashed lines are the alert thresholds: 80% warns, 90% is critical.

panels.title: Used and free space
panels.description: Space used and free on the file system behind each datastore.

panels.title: Growth per day
panels.description: How much the used space changed over the last 24 hours. It rises with each backup and drops when garbage collection frees space, so read it over a week.

panels.title: Days until full at the 7 day trend
panels.description: Free space divided by how fast it has been shrinking over 7 days. Only a datastore that is shrinking is shown; the alert fires when this is under 14 days and the datastore is over 70% full.

panels.title: Datastore throughput
panels.description: Block device throughput behind each datastore. A datastore with no local block device, such as one on a network file system, may show nothing here.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Total CPU use of the host, and the share spent waiting for I/O.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: Load average over 1, 5 and 15 minutes.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Per interface, from the PBS network device counters.

panels.title: Root disk throughput
panels.description: Block device throughput of the host's own disk.

panels.title: Root disk busy and IOPS
panels.description: How busy the host's own disk is (io_ticks is reported in seconds) and its operations per second.

panels.title: Host metrics age
panels.description: Time since PBS last pushed host metrics. PBS pushes every 10 seconds; the alert fires after 10 minutes of silence.

panels.title: Health timer age
panels.description: Time since the health timer on the PBS host last pushed. It runs every 5 minutes; the alert fires after 25 minutes.

panels.title: Health run time
panels.description: How long the last health run took. API calls to a slow or hung datastore disk show up here first.

panels.title: Sources failing
panels.description: Parts of the PBS API the health timer could not read.

panels.title: Services down
panels.description: proxmox-backup or proxmox-backup-proxy not running.

panels.title: Datastores
panels.description: Datastores the health timer checks.

panels.title: Services and sources
panels.description: Whether each PBS service is running, each datastore can be opened, and each source of the health timer was read.

title: Proxmox Backup Server
